comparison.objective: Candidate removes one locked terminal; record selects moving parts and builds a pictured model.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs constrained tab release and coordinated extraction; record performs timed conveyor picking, buffering, discrimination, and stacking.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires one intended terminal out with all surrounding parts intact; record requires a stable four-part model, rejected parts downstream, and no belt jam.
comparison.reason: The conveyor task principally tests perception, scheduling, and sequential assembly rather than latch release.
